subject.title: feat(canvas): export widgets as PNG — copy or download from the card menu

question: Is it acceptable for a Canvas widget document in an opaque-origin sandbox to expose a PNG snapshot to whichever parent embeds it, given the actual Canvas route framing policy?
rationale: The feature’s central design crosses the existing sandbox boundary; source-only checks in the proposed bridge cannot establish whether route-level framing and embedding authority make that exposure safe and intended.

options.title: Confirm framing authority and land with UI proof
options.body: Verify the Canvas document route restricts framing to the intended Control UI context, then capture the real widget-menu copy and download flow with redacted diagnostics.

options.title: Narrow the export authority first
options.body: Change the protocol or route policy so an arbitrary embedding parent cannot request widget pixels before accepting this feature.

recommendation.title: Confirm framing authority and land with UI proof
recommendation.body: Verify the Canvas document route restricts framing to the intended Control UI context, then capture the real widget-menu copy and download flow with redacted diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the snapshot protocol and its browser-harness validation, so they are the best available routing candidate for the technical boundary discussion.
